channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: Why did the football coach go to the bank?
item.description:
Why did the football coach go to the bank?
To get the quarter back.

item.title: Harry: What would you get if you crossed a baseball player with a Boy Scout?
item.description:
Harry: What would you get if you crossed a baseball player with a Boy Scout?
Tom: I don’t know, but I bet he sure could pitch a tent.

item.title: What is the best day of the week to play a double-header?
item.description:
What is the best day of the week to play a double-header?
Tuesday.

item.title: What’s the biggest diamond in the world?
item.description:
What’s the biggest diamond in the world?
A baseball diamond.

item.title: What doesn’t get any wetter no matter how hard it rains?
item.description:
What doesn’t get any wetter no matter how hard it rains?
The ocean.

item.title: How can you carry water in a net?
item.description:
How can you carry water in a net?
Freeze it.

item.title: What do you get when you mix poison ivy with a four-leaf clover?
item.description:
What do you get when you mix poison ivy with a four-leaf clover?
A rash of good luck.

item.title: What’s the difference between Neptune and Earth?
item.description:
What’s the difference between Neptune and Earth?
There’s a world of difference!

item.title: Why did the atom cross the road?
item.description:
Why did the atom cross the road?
Because it was time to split.

item.title: When my girlfriend said she was leaving because of my obsession with The Monkees, I thought she was joking.
item.description:
When my girlfriend said she was leaving because of my obsession with The Monkees, I thought she was joking.
And then I saw her face...
